approval.user_notes: Modo yolo: aprovado automaticamente pelo produtor. 100% local/offline, custo zero.

concept_options.core_message: Cielo builds homes. The homes keep the people.
concept_options.cta: Watch until the lights hum back.
concept_options.hook: Nine A M. The lights hum. The smiles hold too long.
key_points: Morning routine repeats a fraction too perfectly
Corridors loop; doors breathe; the hum deepens
The reveal: the building keeps its people
concept_options.title: Cielo: An Average Day (That Smiles Back)
concept_options.visual_approach: Liminal fluorescent office rendered in code: mustard grids, long corridors, CRT scanlines, VHS glitches, chromatic aberration, film grain, pulsing red reveal
concept_options.why_this_works: Title-card beats escalate dread without exposition; liminal visuals + sound design carry horror inside 60s; fully programmatic so it renders offline on a phone.

concept_options.cta: Count the doors on your floor tonight.
concept_options.hook: Cielo hands you the keys. Keep them.
concept_options.title: Cielo: Key Handover (Found Footage)
concept_options.visual_approach: Fake handheld VHS walkthrough of model homes with tracking errors
concept_options.why_this_works: Strong for horror fans but narrower; found-footage shaky-cam is harder to synthesize cleanly in pure code.

concept_options.hook: You will hear the hum before you see it.
concept_options.title: Cielo: The Hum Beneath the Fluorescent
concept_options.visual_approach: Minimal visuals, drone-led pacing with pulse and dropouts
concept_options.why_this_works: Great audio showcase but risks boring viewers on mute; visuals need to stay loud per the brief.

line_items.notes: Edge-TTS cloud free tier for narration; espeak/sox synth fallback offline
line_items.operation: Narration via tts_selector (edge_tts primary, synth fallback)

line_items.notes: Pure-python Pillow/numpy frame synthesis, zero API cost
line_items.operation: 6 programmatic scenes rendered as PNG frames

line_items.notes: numpy/scipy synth drone + pulse + hum, mixed with ffmpeg

metadata.decision: composition_mode atelier REJECTED for this run: no Remotion/Node runtime on phone; ffmpeg templated path chosen and logged.
metadata.delivery_promise_ref: motion_led via programmatic frames (30fps) packed by ffmpeg

production_plan.art_direction: CIELO-CREEPY-NOIR: mustard-fluorescent liminal office (#E8C547 grids on #0A0A0C), CRT scanlines + VHS tracking + chromatic split + grain on every beat, deadpan corporate titles in monospace, blood-red (#C1121F) reserved for the reveal, slow push-in camera feel via programmatic zoom, letterbox 2.35:1.

music_source.mood_direction: 60 BPM dark drone in D minor, sub pulse, fluorescent hum at 120Hz, riser into reveal, dropout stingers

stages.approach: Map OpenMontage cinematic stages to local tools; research done via web_search (liminal + analog horror).
Beat map hook -> escalation -> reveal -> landing, ~120 WPM title-led narration.
6 scenes x 10s, hero frames explicit, 5-aspect specs in metadata.
Pillow/numpy frames + edge-tts narration + synth drone; sample-first per asset-director.
Emotion-first cuts, hard cuts + fade to black, title windows restrained.
ffmpeg 1280x720 30fps libx264 + aac, grade + grain + letterbox, -14 LUFS-ish mix.
Hero MP4 + poster frame + publish log.

voice_selection.delivery_style: Deadpan corporate narrator, calm at first, flattening into something wrong by the reveal.
voice_selection.pacing_policy: Slow ~120 WPM. Short pauses after setup lines, long pause before the reveal. One delivery idea per beat.
voice_selection.provider: edge-tts (tts_selector route; Piper requested but Bionic-incompatible binary)
voice_selection.rationale: Piper aarch64 binary aborts on Termux (TLS underaligned); edge-tts gives directed English narration free. Offline synth fallback if network fails.

modifications: Narration in English per original brief; burned-in titles carry the story on mute
selected_concept.rationale: C1 best fuses the brief (average day at small housing company Cielo + creepy/surreal twist) with the proven liminal + analog-horror craft from research, and renders fully programmatically.
